# Licence policy for runtime dependencies

## Expressions

Licence expressions use SPDX syntax: identifiers combined with AND and OR (AND binds tighter, parentheses group) and WITH followed by an
exception. Identifiers and operators are case-insensitive. Canonical form: identifiers as listed below, operators in upper case,
parentheses only around an OR inside an AND, operands in their written order. NOASSERTION and unknown identifiers have class unknown.

## Classes

Classes from least to most restrictive: permissive, weak, strong, network, unknown. An OR expression takes the least restrictive class of
its operands, an AND expression the most restrictive. An identifier WITH an exception takes the exception's class when the identifier is
listed, otherwise unknown.

| identifier | class |
|---|---|
| 0BSD | permissive |
| AGPL-3.0-only | network |
| AGPL-3.0-or-later | network |
| Apache-2.0 | permissive |
| BSD-2-Clause | permissive |
| BSD-3-Clause | permissive |
| BSL-1.0 | permissive |
| CDDL-1.0 | weak |
| EPL-1.0 | weak |
| EPL-2.0 | weak |
| GPL-2.0-only | strong |
| GPL-2.0-or-later | strong |
| GPL-3.0-only | strong |
| GPL-3.0-or-later | strong |
| ISC | permissive |
| LGPL-2.1-only | weak |
| LGPL-2.1-or-later | weak |
| LGPL-3.0-only | weak |
| LGPL-3.0-or-later | weak |
| MIT | permissive |
| MPL-2.0 | weak |
| PSF-2.0 | permissive |
| SSPL-1.0 | network |
| Unlicense | permissive |
| Zlib | permissive |

| exception | class |
|---|---|
| Classpath-exception-2.0 | weak |
| GCC-exception-3.1 | weak |
| LLVM-exception | permissive |

Deprecated identifiers read as their canonical identifiers:

| deprecated | canonical |
|---|---|
| AGPL-3.0 | AGPL-3.0-only |
| GPL-2.0 | GPL-2.0-only |
| GPL-2.0+ | GPL-2.0-or-later |
| GPL-3.0 | GPL-3.0-only |
| GPL-3.0+ | GPL-3.0-or-later |
| LGPL-2.1 | LGPL-2.1-only |
| LGPL-2.1+ | LGPL-2.1-or-later |
| LGPL-3.0 | LGPL-3.0-only |

Long names read as identifiers:

| long name | identifier |
|---|---|
| Apache 2.0 | Apache-2.0 |
| Apache License 2.0 | Apache-2.0 |
| BSD 3-Clause | BSD-3-Clause |
| ISC License | ISC |
| MIT License | MIT |
| Mozilla Public License 2.0 | MPL-2.0 |

## Exceptions register

Each exception row grants its class to the releases of its package that its range admits. Its range uses the package ecosystem's
constraint syntax.
